cd7r2_mandate: CD-7R2 — Secondary Entry / Re-entry Architecture: recover part of the 'no-deep-pullback but structurally healthy' missed opportunities WITHOUT becoming CHASE. TWO distinct non-chasing mechanisms now recognized: [price-pullback型 PRIMARY_ZONE: price returns into band] and [time-consolidation型 SECONDARY_ZONE: band itself rises toward price — price flat + cost center/upper band rising + distance_to_band converging + lifecycle not DECAY]. Terminology frozen: PRIMARY_ZONE_ENTRY / SECONDARY_ENTRY (never-entered episodes' second chance, priority A) / RE_ENTRY (post-exit re-establishment, priority B, DEFERRED this round). HARD BOUNDARY: secondary entry must NOT degenerate to 'no pullback + continuous rise -> buy anyway' (CHASE revival under a new name) — it must require time-for-space digestion (convergence + band-rising), which is economically distinct from 'strong so buy'. PROTOCOL: ARM A CHASE (historical control only) / ARM B PRIMARY_ZONE (R1 frozen verbatim) / ARM C PRIMARY+SECONDARY (candidate) — test only C-vs-B incrementality. METRICS (five): top-decile capture / MAE / adverse rate / entry delay / incremental entries; MANDATORY stratified report: PRIMARY entries vs SECONDARY-only entries vs NEVER-entered (top-decile rate, MAE, adverse each) — 'if secondary only recovers winners but MAE/adverse regress to CHASE levels, it is worthless'. SUCCESS CRITERION (Pareto, frozen): NOT capture-back-to-CHASE; target = keep most of PRIMARY's MAE improvement while recovering meaningful missed upside (MAE slightly worse allowed, capture clearly up, ret_rel improved, adverse not significantly worse). STOP RULE (frozen now, no R3/R4 ladder): if SECONDARY cannot simultaneously retain position improvement AND recover meaningful missed upside, then the observable data's information boundary for precise entry timing has been reached — STOP timing expansion, record the boundary honestly, then decide CD-7D/deployment as a RISK-MANAGEMENT system. CD-7D ENTRY CONDITIONS UPDATED: PRIMARY+SECONDARY architecture frozen + no known structural funnel defect + holdout risk/return trade-off acceptable (ret_rel>0 NOT required — system may be absolute-risk-management first, relative-alpha second); forbidden: fine-tuning position sizes over a known-incomplete entry architecture.
